title: Calibrating the Performance Assessment Mechanism in Virtual Laboratories with a Reinforcement Learning-Inspired Technique
reason: Recalibrates the Onlabs virtual-lab step-order scoring with reinforcement learning on automated sessions of a non-playable character, with no human expert or student data. No student sample enters this paper's analysis.

extraction.design: algorithm design and simulation (RL on NPC)
extraction.population: none in this paper (NPC simulation); earlier calibrations used human gameplay sessions
extraction.notes: Secondary code: NOREL (no indicator related to student success). Earlier GA/ANN calibration against expert grading is cited as prior work, not reported here.
